title: Polarized training has greater impact on key endurance variables than threshold, high intensity, or high volume training
claims: In a nine-week randomized comparison of four training models, the polarized group showed the greatest increase in VO2peak.
The polarized group increased VO2peak by 6.8 mL/min/kg, or 11.7%.
The polarized group increased time to exhaustion during a ramp protocol by 17.4% and peak velocity/power by 5.1%.
Velocity or power at 4 mmol/L lactate increased after polarized training by 8.1 ± 4.6% (P<0.01).

claimVerification.note: 摘要/正文：9 周随机四组比较，POL 组 VO2peak 增幅最大。
正文：TTE 提高 17.4%，峰值速度/功率提高 5.1%。
正文表：POL 在 4 mmol/L 的速度/功率提高 8.1±4.6%（P<0.01）。

verification.note: 全文可读；4 mmol/L 行显示 8.1±4.6%，已按原文改正 claim。
